evaluation.target: Monthly mean GHI * 10 m² * 0.20; theoretical kWh/day, not observed PV output
evaluation.dataset_hash_scope: SHA-256 with CSV CRLF normalized to LF; content unchanged across Git checkouts
evaluation.provenance: Inherited NASA POWER-labelled bundled CSV; original upstream API receipt/raw responses not independently verified. Whitespace normalized; no new data fetched.
evaluation.qualification: No future-year holdout, no observed installation data; five cities were predeclared, no tuning or all-city refit. Nairobi is held out.

assumptions: Tariff default KES 25/kWh is a fictional demo assumption created 2026-10-13, not a verified Kenyan tariff. Enter your own variable electricity rate; fixed charges and tax are excluded.
Business load, operating hours, installation cost and maintenance defaults are fictional examples, not observed SME measurements.
Formula consumption is average load in kW × operating hours/day × representative days/month; measured mode uses your supplied monthly kWh. Annual consumption assumes twelve identical months.
Self-consumption fraction is a user assumption. Usable solar is capped against consumption each month; export revenue is zero.
Panel-area and efficiency changes scale the model reference target linearly, not a separately learned model.
limitations: Nairobi XGBoost MAPE is 12.5268%, worse than the training-city monthly baseline at 8.4342%; default baseline is a transparent comparison-driven choice, not an independent new validation result.
Nairobi only; no automatic geography inference. No verified local installation output or customer savings evidence.
Solar target is derived from bundled irradiance with fixed panel area and efficiency, not measured installation generation. Baseline and held-out metrics describe that derived target only.
Climatological monthly estimates omit shading, roof orientation, inverter losses, batteries, degradation and weather extremes.
Simple payback omits financing, discounting, replacement costs and tax; this is scenario arithmetic, not financial advice or validated ROI.
